groups.content:
**Number System - Lectures 1.1-1.3** — Topical Exam 1.

90 questions, 90 marks, 100 minutes. Each correct answer earns 1 mark; each wrong answer costs 0.25. Unanswered questions score zero.

This is an **offline sitting**. The questions are on your printed question paper — this screen is the answer sheet. Shade the letter matching your choice for each question number.

questions.stem: What is the units digit of $7^{23}$?
If $x < 0 < y$ and $|x| > |y|$, what is the sign of $x+y$?
Which of the following is irrational?
If $|2x - 5| = 11$, what is the sum of all possible values of $x$?

Two rotating wheels return to their initial orientation every 15 seconds and 20 seconds, respectively. If both are in their initial orientation right now, after how many seconds will they next simultaneously return to their initial orientation?
What is the GCF of 48 and 180?
Two positive integers have a GCF of 12 and an LCM of 144. What is their product?
What is the largest integer that must divide the product of any four consecutive integers?
If $|2x+7|=|x-1|$, what is the sum of all possible values of $x$?
How many even integers are there from 1 to 99, inclusive?
If $a$ is irrational, which of the following is always irrational?
What is the sign of $(-2)^{10}\times(-3)^{7}$?
What is the LCM of 105 and 165?
Two lighthouses flash every 9 seconds and every 12 seconds, respectively. If they flash together right now, in how many seconds will they next flash together?
What is the units digit of $2^{100}$?
Divisibility by 45 can be tested by checking divisibility by which pair of numbers?
How many positive divisors does 90 have?
Three joggers complete a lap in 8, 14, and 21 minutes, respectively. If they start together, after how many minutes will they next all be at the starting point together?
A five-digit number ends in "00." Which of the following must be true about the number?
Using the double-and-subtract method, is 4,928 divisible by 7?

options.text: No, since $492-16=476$ is not divisible by 7
No, since the digit sum isn't divisible by 7
Cannot be determined without long division

questions.stem: If the product of $n$ negative numbers is positive, which of the following must be true about $n$?
What is the remainder when the product of any 3 consecutive integers is divided by 6?
What is the remainder when $3^{100}$ is divided by 11?
What is the sum of all positive divisors of 24?
If the sum of five consecutive integers is even, what must be true about the smallest of the five?

options.text: It can be either even or odd

questions.stem: The sum of four consecutive odd integers is 96. What is the largest of the four integers?
Any set of 7 consecutive integers must contain exactly how many multiples of 7?
A positive integer greater than 10 leaves a remainder of 5 when divided by each of 6, 8, and 10. What is the smallest such integer?
If $x$ is any integer, what is the parity of $x^3+x$?
If $x$ is rational and $y$ is irrational, which of the following is impossible?
Which of the following numbers has exactly three positive divisors?
For how many integers $x$ does $|x-5| < 3$ hold?
If $|x-4|\le 6$, what is the largest possible value of $x$?
Is $\sqrt{225}+\sqrt2$ rational or irrational?

options.text: Rational, since $\sqrt{225}$ is a whole number
Rational, since both terms are positive
Rational, since 225 is a perfect square

questions.stem: What is the sign of $(-1)^{100}\times(-1)^{101}$?

options.text: Depends on parity of the exponents

questions.stem: Which of the following numbers has an ODD number of positive factors?
If $a,b,c$ are three consecutive integers in increasing order and $a$ is even, what is the parity of $a+2b-c$?

options.text: Even only if $a$ is a multiple of 4

questions.stem: If $n$ is a positive integer, what is $(n+1)(n+2)-n(n+1)$?
If $n = 2^a \times 3^b$ is a perfect square with exactly 15 positive factors, where $a,b$ are both positive integers, what is $a+b$?
If $|a|=|b|$ and $a \neq b$, which of the following must be true?
If $a$ is a factor of both 60 and 84, what is the largest possible value of $a$?
The GCF of two positive integers is 15 and their LCM is 450. If one of the integers is 90, what is the other?
Which of the following is divisible by both 5 and 8?
Which of the following could be the greatest common factor of two distinct positive integers $p$ and $q$? I. 1   II. $p$   III. $p+q$
What is the largest integer that must divide the product of any five consecutive positive integers?
A number leaves remainders of 1, 3, and 5 when divided by 6, 8, and 10, respectively. What is the smallest such positive number?
How many factors of 196 are themselves perfect squares?
Which of the following is divisible by both 4 and 9?
What is the minimum possible value of $|x+3|+|x-3|$?
Which of the following is divisible by 4 and by 3, but NOT by 9?
What is the least prime number greater than 95?
What is the remainder when $2^{50}$ is divided by 7?
What is the GCF of 90 and 126?
If $n \equiv 4 \pmod{12}$, what is the remainder when $n$ is divided by 4?
If $x$ is a nonzero rational number and $y$ is irrational, which of the following could be rational?
How many prime numbers are there strictly between 90 and 100?
If $x^5 < 0$, what must be true about $x^4$?
What is the sign of $(-5)^7\times(-2)^4\times3$?
What is the sum of all prime numbers between 70 and 80?
If $x<0$, what is $|x|+x$?
If the product of six integers is negative, what is the minimum number of negative factors among them?
Which of the following is a perfect square?
Is $0.101001000100001\ldots$ (with an ever-lengthening run of zeros between the 1's) rational or irrational?

options.text: Irrational, since its decimal expansion is nonterminating and not eventually periodic
Rational, since it has a visible pattern
Rational, since it is less than 1
Rational, since it is a decimal

questions.stem: Which of the following is divisible by 11?
How many odd positive divisors does 360 have?
What is the remainder when the square of an odd integer is divided by 4?
If $a$ and $b$ are each divisible by 12, which of the following must also be divisible by 12?
If $N$ is divisible by 6 different prime numbers, what is the least possible value of $N$?
What is the smallest 4-digit number divisible by 9?
If $n$ is an even integer, what is the remainder when $n^2$ is divided by 4?
Which of the following must be irrational?
If $n=5^a\times7^b$ is a perfect square with exactly 21 positive factors, where $a,b$ are positive integers, what is $a\times b$?
How many positive divisors does 100 have?
What is the smallest positive integer by which 180 must be multiplied so that the result is a perfect square?
If $p$ and $q$ are distinct prime numbers, each greater than 5, which of the following must be odd?
If $n\equiv3\pmod8$, what is the remainder when $3n$ is divided by 8?
If two positive integers have no common factor other than 1, what is their LCM in terms of their product?
Divisibility by 66 can be tested by checking divisibility by which pair of numbers?
Which of the following is divisible by 13?
How many factors of 324 are themselves perfect squares?
A positive integer leaves a remainder of 4 when divided by 9 and a remainder of 2 when divided by 7. What is the smallest such positive integer?
What is the LCM of 12, 18, and 30?
If $N$ is divisible by a prime number that is also even, which of the following must be true about $N$?
If $a$ is a factor of both 84 and 126, what is the largest possible value of $a$?
A six-digit number ends in the digits "375." Which of the following must be true about the number?
If $a$ and $b$ are integers and $a^2-b^2$ is odd, what must be true about $a+b$?
The sum of six consecutive integers is 87. What is the largest of the six integers?
If $m$ is an even integer and $n$ is an odd integer, what is the parity of $m^2 + 3n^2$?
What is the remainder when 137 is divided by 9?
A number leaves a remainder of 7 when divided by 15. What is the remainder when the same number is divided by 5?
